label: FSoE

payload_bytes.label: Payload
payload_bytes.description: Actual selected-direction safe data: one byte or even count for reviewed base format; mapped complete container capacity is separate.
payload_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

target_bus_load_percent.label: Ziel-Buslast
target_bus_load_percent.description: Zielwert fuer die aus Routing, Payload, Zyklus und Bitrate berechnete Buslast.

fsoe_profile.label: profile
fsoe_profile.description: Source-qualified base declaration proposal; ETG5120 enhancements require independent matched edition/implementation bounds.
fsoe_profile.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_role.label: role
fsoe_role.description: Actual safety protocol instance role; EtherCAT main-device/subdevice roles are independent.
fsoe_role.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_transport_binding.label: transport binding
fsoe_transport_binding.description: Required actual black-channel link/process-data/buffer mapping reference; no implicit EtherCAT100M/Ethernet inherited rate.
fsoe_transport_binding.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_implementation_source.label: implementation source
fsoe_implementation_source.description: Required matched actual safety device/firmware/protocol edition and supported data limits reference, unknown.
fsoe_implementation_source.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_connection_source.label: connection source
fsoe_connection_source.description: Required actual unique connection ID/slave address/parameter/configuration reference, unknown.
fsoe_connection_source.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_timing_source.label: timing source
fsoe_timing_source.description: Required actual direction-dependent watchdog/whole exchange/transport mapping bounds and endpoint timing reference, unknown.
fsoe_timing_source.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_direction.label: direction
fsoe_direction.description: Actual safe-data direction. Configured input/output lengths may differ; never duplicate one length into both.
fsoe_direction.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_master_safe_bytes.label: master safe bytes
fsoe_master_safe_bytes.description: Actual master-to-slave safe-data capacity, unknown. One byte or even count; bounded by actual device/process-data mapping.
fsoe_master_safe_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_slave_safe_bytes.label: slave safe bytes
fsoe_slave_safe_bytes.description: Actual slave-to-master safe-data capacity, unknown, independent of master direction. No universal1486-byte maximum.
fsoe_slave_safe_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_crc_count.label: crc count
fsoe_crc_count.description: Actual CRC word count=ceil(selected safe bytes/2). One-byte exception uses virtual zero in CRC calculation, not an extra wire payload byte.
fsoe_crc_count.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_crc_word_bytes.label: crc word bytes
fsoe_crc_word_bytes.description: Baseline two-octet CRC field per block; not a single checksum overhead for all safe data.
fsoe_crc_word_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_command_bytes.label: command bytes
fsoe_command_bytes.description: Baseline one command octet; not an EtherCAT datagram header.
fsoe_command_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_connection_bytes.label: connection bytes
fsoe_connection_bytes.description: Baseline two ConnID octets at end of PDU; connection identifier differs from safety slave address.
fsoe_connection_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_frame_bytes.label: frame bytes
fsoe_frame_bytes.description: Actual safety container CMD+safe data+2*CRCcount+ConnID. Six-byte minimum corresponds to one safe byte; excludes black-channel framing.
fsoe_frame_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_pdo_capacity_bytes.label: pdo capacity bytes
fsoe_pdo_capacity_bytes.description: Actual mapped black-channel process-data container capacity; full FSoE frame must fit, not just safe payload.
fsoe_pdo_capacity_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_state.label: state
fsoe_state.description: Actual protocol state, unknown. Saved state declaration does not execute handshake or release safe outputs.
fsoe_state.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_data_command.label: data command
fsoe_data_command.description: Actual outgoing data-state command, unknown. Independent peer command is not inferred; no auto ProcessData release.
fsoe_data_command.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_command.label: command
fsoe_command.description: Actual wire command octet. Public base Reset0x2A/Data Process0x36/FailSafe0x08 constraints; remaining startup command encoding requires source.
fsoe_command.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_conn_id.label: conn id
fsoe_conn_id.description: Actual16-bit ConnID unknown. Zero before connection allocation/reset; Data requires nonzero. Uniqueness requires actual network configuration.
fsoe_conn_id.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_slave_address.label: slave address
fsoe_slave_address.description: Actual configured16-bit safety slave address, unknown; must match endpoint setting. Distinct from EtherCAT address and ConnID.
fsoe_slave_address.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_peer_address.label: peer address
fsoe_peer_address.description: Actual peer accepted/configured safety slave address, unknown, must equal selected endpoint address; scalar equality is not commissioning evidence.
fsoe_peer_address.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_session_id.label: session id
fsoe_session_id.description: Actual locally generated16-bit session ID, unknown. Not default0, not an on-wire field in every Data PDU.
fsoe_session_id.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_peer_session_id.label: peer session id
fsoe_peer_session_id.description: Actual independently generated peer session ID, unknown. Not forced equal to local session or copied from it.
fsoe_peer_session_id.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_sequence.label: sequence
fsoe_sequence.description: Actual internal virtual sequence, unknown; base Data1..65535, absent as a standalone wire field. Increment/rollover/CRC-change mechanism needs executor.
fsoe_sequence.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_crc0.label: crc0
fsoe_crc0.description: Actual current16-bit CRC0, unknown. Scalar bounds do not recompute CRC chain/virtual sequence/session/ConnID/block index.
fsoe_crc0.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_previous_crc0.label: previous crc0
fsoe_previous_crc0.description: Actual previous received CRC0 in inherited chain, unknown. Not default0 outside actual reset.
fsoe_previous_crc0.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_crc_source.label: crc source
fsoe_crc_source.description: Actual encoded/container/chain/sequence/session/block-index integrity evidence, unknown. Safety CRC is not cryptographic authentication.
fsoe_crc_source.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_master_watchdog_ms.label: master watchdog ms
fsoe_master_watchdog_ms.description: Actual base communication watchdog1..65535ms from matched configuration; no universal shortest1ms or sampled1000ms default.
fsoe_master_watchdog_ms.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_slave_watchdog_ms.label: slave watchdog ms
fsoe_slave_watchdog_ms.description: Actual peer accepted same connection communication watchdog, independently sourced; setting alone is not a live watchdog or safety-response certificate.
fsoe_slave_watchdog_ms.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_exchange_bound_ms.label: exchange bound ms
fsoe_exchange_bound_ms.description: Actual complete bidirectional exchange bound, unknown, must be below both configured watchdogs. Not a single EtherCAT frame cycle.
fsoe_exchange_bound_ms.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_parameter_bytes.label: parameter bytes
fsoe_parameter_bytes.description: Actual complete parameter-transfer stream bytes, unknown. Fragmented across frames if needed; not restricted to one frame or copied safe-data length.
fsoe_parameter_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_parameter_remaining_bytes.label: parameter remaining bytes
fsoe_parameter_remaining_bytes.description: Actual remaining parameter stream count0..actual total, unknown. Counter alone does not certify accepted safety application parameters.
fsoe_parameter_remaining_bytes.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_parameters_accepted.label: parameters accepted
fsoe_parameters_accepted.description: Actual peer parameter acceptance unknown; Data requires true declaration, but protocol/runtime acceptance remains unexecuted.
fsoe_parameters_accepted.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_mapping_source.label: mapping source
fsoe_mapping_source.description: Actual ESI/PDO/black-channel buffering and direction/mapping version evidence, unknown; require verification after parameter changes.
fsoe_mapping_source.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_safe_output_source.label: safe output source
fsoe_safe_output_source.description: Actual defined failure/output response and safety application configuration, unknown. Do not infer all-zero application safe state universally.
fsoe_safe_output_source.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_safety_requirement.label: safety requirement
fsoe_safety_requirement.description: Actual project safety-integrity requirement, unknown. Protocol capability alone does not certify device/system SIL or PL.
fsoe_safety_requirement.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

fsoe_assurance_source.label: assurance source
fsoe_assurance_source.description: Actual matched safety-device/system validation/response/certificate reference, unknown. NIS declaration checks are not a safety certification.
fsoe_assurance_source.source_revision: Beckhoff PC-Control01/2007 pages24-26; HMS public FSoE PDU/state tutorial July23/24 2026 interpreted for base ETG5100v1.2.0, not licensed full text

parameter_proposals.note: FSoE has no own bitrate, universal safe-data maximum or universal watchdog default. Base one-byte/even-block container requires configured directional data/mapping, CRC chain and endpoint watchdog. Black channel and optional enhancements need their own profiles; no automatic SIL/PL acceptance.

known_limitations: Technology-specific conformance details require a vendor/profile extension.
